heading.label: Heading
heading.info: Shown at the top of the review widget. Translatable in Translate & Adapt.

show_qna.label: Show the review Q&A box
show_qna.info: Shoppers ask a question and get an answer grounded in your reviews. Also needs the Review Q&A toggle in the app's Settings.

enable_product_widget.label: Show the review widget on product pages
enable_product_widget.info: Mounts the full review widget automatically — no app block needed. Works on every theme.

placement_selector.label: Widget placement (CSS selector, optional)
placement_selector.info: Leave empty for automatic placement below the product information. Enter a CSS selector to mount the widget after a specific element instead.

show_pdp_title_badge.label: Show stars under the product title

pdp_badge_position.label: Stars position (product page & product cards)
pdp_badge_position.info: Where the star rating and count appear: directly under the product name, or under the tagline. Applies on product pages AND under product names on the home page and collection pages.

pdp_badge_selector.label: Stars placement (CSS selector, optional)
pdp_badge_selector.info: Advanced: the stars are inserted after the first element matching this selector, overriding the position choice.

enable_badges.label: Show star badges on product cards site-wide
enable_badges.info: Adds star ratings next to product names on the home page, collections, and search results for products with published reviews.

card_badge_position.label: Star badge position on product lists
card_badge_position.info: Where the stars sit inside collection and home page product cards. “Same as product page” follows the Product-page stars position setting.

cart_badges.label: Show star badges in the cart
cart_badges.info: Shows each cart item's star rating above its quantity selector, on the cart page and in the cart drawer.

badge_selector.label: Card title element (CSS selector, optional)
badge_selector.info: Advanced: only needed if badges don't find your theme's product card titles automatically.

show_qna.label: Show the review Q&A box
show_qna.info: Adds a question box above the reviews that answers from your customers' reviews, with exact quotes.

show_product_links.label: Link each review to its product
